title: Merchant onboarding
description: Finish the required steps to launch your Lotzi merchant profile.

stepDescriptions.BUSINESS: Tell customers what you sell and how to reach you.
stepDescriptions.BRANDING: Add a logo, banner, and store voice.
stepDescriptions.LOCATION: Set your service address and delivery area.
stepDescriptions.PREFERENCES: Choose order, payout, and notification preferences.
stepDescriptions.REVIEW: Check everything before you submit for launch.

placeholders.description: Write a short, clear description for local customers.

helper.logo: Use a square PNG or JPG under 2 MB.
helper.banner: Use a wide banner image for your storefront.
helper.gstin: GSTIN is optional for businesses that do not need it.
helper.deliveryRadius: Customers inside this distance can place delivery orders.
helper.snapshotRestored: Your form progress was restored after changing language.

validation.phone: Enter a valid Indian mobile number.
validation.descriptionMin: Description must be at least {min} characters.
validation.openDaysRequired: Select at least one open day.

toasts.submitted: Your store has been submitted for review.
toasts.launched: Your store is ready to launch.
toasts.snapshotExpired: Saved language-switch progress expired. Please review the step again.
